contests.title: Contests
contests.intro: Weekly races between players. When a week ends, the leader of each contest wins the cash prize shown and a new round starts. New corporations and characters join at the start of the next round.
contests.referralIntro: Invite players with your link. A referral counts when the player you invite creates a character.
contests.entrants: {count, plural, =0 {No entries yet} one {# entry} other {# entries}}
contests.noRound: The next round opens after the coming turn.
contests.noLeaders: No one is ahead yet. Any gain takes the lead.
contests.notEntered: You have no entry this round.
contests.signInToTrack: Sign in to see where you stand.

corp_growth_small.title: Small business growth
corp_growth_small.rules: Percent growth in market cap for player-run corporations in the smaller half of the field. Capital you inject during the round does not count.

corp_growth_large.title: Big business growth
corp_growth_large.rules: Percent growth in market cap for player-run corporations in the larger half of the field. Capital you inject during the round does not count.

influence_gain.title: National Influence
influence_gain.rules: Most National Influence gained during the round.

approval_gain.title: Government approval
approval_gain.rules: Most approval points gained by a government led by a player. The same leader must hold office for the whole round.

referrals_weekly.title: Weekly referrals
referrals_weekly.rules: Most new players brought in this week.

referrals_iteration.title: This iteration
referrals_iteration.rules: Most new players brought in this iteration. Counting restarts when a new iteration begins.

referrals.yourCount: {count, plural, =0 {You have no referrals this iteration yet.} one {You have # referral this iteration.} other {You have # referrals this iteration.}}
referrals.none: No referrals yet. Be the first.
referrals.notRunning: The referral contest starts after the next turn.

contests.iterationPrize: Supporter for the whole next iteration
